To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the levels of soluble interleuken-2 receptor- α are increased in the serum of patients with epithelial ovarian tumors, and that the levels of this marker in the serum of the patients are correlated with the levels in the cystic fluids from these tumors.
1) Serum IL-2R-α levels at the time of diagnosis of epithelial ovarian tumors are correlated to tumor stage and to the presence of metastatic lesions.
serum and cystic fluid levels of sIL-2R-α were significantly higher in ovarian cancer patients than in healthy blood donors and benign ovarian tumor patients.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the soluble IL-2R in ovarian cancer and its potential use as a marker for the disease.
the role of IL-2 in the pathogenesis of epithelial ovarian cancer.
the clinical significance of soluble IL-2R in the diagnosis, prognosis, and monitoring of ovarian cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
serum levels of IL 2Rα are not a useful tool in the management of ovarian cancer.
the serum levels of IL2-Rα are a useful tumor marker for epithelial ovarian tumors and may have a prognostic significance.

the measurement of IL-2 receptor- α in the serum or in the cystic fluid of patients with ovarian cancer may provide useful information in diagnosis, staging and follow-up of patients with ovarian tumors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IL-2R is a useful marker for diagnosis and follow-up of ovarian cancer.
serum and cystic fluid levels of IL-1β, IL-2Rβ, IL-6 and IL-8 are correlated in patients with epithelial ovarian tumors and that IL-6 is a good predictor of disease progression.
IL-2R levels are a good marker for ovarian cancer, but not as good as CA 125.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IL-2R is a useful marker of disease progression and may be useful in the diagnosis of ovarian tumors.
IL-2R levels in cystic fluid may be a useful tool to distinguish malignant from benign ovarian cystic tumors.
serum IL-2R levels may be used to distinguish patients with ovarian cancer from those with benign ovarian tumors.
